propositions: Infra exceptions (LLMUnavailableError) at gates must emit an additive ERROR sidecar record with schema gate_error_v1, verdict=ERROR, and error cause/evidence_ref, without changing pre-existing gate outcomes (INDETERMINATE degrade for plan/code-review, exception propagation for completion).
Gate ERROR records use a dedicated schema tag gate_error_v1 separate from verdict schemas so the ERROR verdict is never coerced to FAIL by reconcile_verdict or other verdict routers.

Existing verdict readers (latest_review_result, latest_fail_verdict) must remain unchanged and skip gate_error_v1 records via schema guards, ensuring ERROR records do not surface as verdicts or pollute verdict reads.
Domain-level BLOCK/FAIL exceptions (non-infra) must not emit ERROR records; only infrastructure-exception paths write ERROR records.
The ERROR record is written on existing event types (REVIEW_RESULT, COMPLETION_VERDICT) with no new event type introduction, maintaining back-compat and replay safety.
